# Security

Pointy runs a local server on `127.0.0.1:7777` and a browser extension that reads the
pages you mark up, so security reports matter.

**Please don't open a public issue for a vulnerability.** Report it privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/HamzaBinMubeen/pointy/security/advisories/new).

Only the latest release is supported.
